# OpenFile

> 572+ free, open-source file tools that run entirely in the browser. PDFs, images, video, audio, data, code and more. Files are processed on the user's device with WebAssembly, Canvas and on-device AI. Nothing is uploaded, there is no account and no watermark.

Key facts:
- Every tool runs client-side. There is no file upload endpoint.
- Some tools download an open-source engine once (ffmpeg.wasm, Tesseract, AI models), then work offline.
- Each tool has its own page at https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/<slug> with steps, tips and an FAQ.
- Search tools: https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/tools?q=<words>. Filter by format: https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/tools?format=PDF
- MIT licensed: https://github.com/aniruddhaadak80/OpenFile

## Categories
- [PDF Tools](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/category/pdf): Merge, split, sign, protect and edit PDFs. 63 tools.
- [Convert](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/category/convert): Move between PDF, Office, Markdown, HTML and images. 35 tools.
- [Image](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/category/image): Compress, resize, crop, remove backgrounds, upscale. 60 tools.
- [Video](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/category/video): Trim, compress, convert, GIF and record. 40 tools.
- [Audio](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/category/audio): Edit, convert, record and transcribe. 26 tools.
- [Developer](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/category/dev): JSON, JWT, regex, hashes, cURL and more. 65 tools.
- [Text & Data](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/category/text): Diff, count, convert tables, format text. 47 tools.
- [Design](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/category/design): Colors, CSS, favicons, SVG, whiteboards. 21 tools.
- [Data](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/category/data): CSV, Excel, JSON, SQLite, Parquet, maps and GPS. 15 tools.

## Popular tools
- [Merge PDF](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDFs into one ordered document with drag-and-drop sorting.
- [Split PDF](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/split-pdf): Split by ranges, every N pages, or extract each page into a ZIP.
- [Compress PDF](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/compress-pdf): Shrink PDF size with smart image downsampling and stream compression.
- [Sign PDF](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/sign-pdf): Draw, type or upload a signature and place it anywhere, plus dates and initials.
- [Invoice Generator](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/invoice-generator): Create GST/VAT invoices with automatic totals and a polished PDF.
- [PDF to Image](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/pdf-to-image): Export PDF pages as crisp PNG, JPG or WEBP at any DPI.
- [Image to PDF](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/image-to-pdf): Combine JPG, PNG and WEBP into one PDF with page-size controls.
- [PDF to Word](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/pdf-to-word): Convert PDF text into an editable DOCX document.
- [Word to PDF](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/word-to-pdf): Turn DOCX files into well-formatted PDFs.
- [Image Compressor](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/image-compressor): Shrink images in bulk with quality and width controls and live savings.
- [Image Converter](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/image-converter): Convert JPG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF, BMP, GIF and ICO in bulk.
- [Image Resizer](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/image-resizer): Resize to exact pixels, percentages or social presets.
- [Background Remover](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/background-remover): Remove image backgrounds with on-device AI. Replace with color or blur.
- [Video Trimmer](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/video-trimmer): Trim and cut clips with a visual timeline, no re-upload.
- [Video Compressor](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/video-compressor): Compress videos with quality presets and target resolution.
- [Screen Recorder](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/screen-recorder): Record screen + webcam bubble with mic and system audio.
- [Audio Editor & Trimmer](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/audio-editor): Trim, fade in/out, change volume and export with a waveform.
- [JSON Formatter](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/json-formatter): Prettify, validate, minify and explore JSON as a tree.
- [QR Code Generator](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/qr-generator): QR codes for links, Wi-Fi, vCards and text with colors and logo.
- [Diff Checker](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/diff-checker): Compare text and code side-by-side or inline.
- [Color Palette Extractor](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/color-palette): Extract dominant colors and export CSS/Tailwind palettes.
- [Create Fillable PDF Form](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/create-pdf-form): Add text fields, checkboxes, radio buttons, dropdowns, lists and signature fields to any PDF.
- [Extract PDF Images](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/extract-pdf-images): Pull embedded images out of a PDF at original quality and download them as a ZIP.
- [Scan to PDF](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/scan-to-pdf): Turn phone photos or your camera into a clean multi-page PDF: edge detection, straightening, black and white.
- [3D Model Viewer](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/3d-viewer): View GLB, GLTF, OBJ, STL, PLY, FBX, 3MF, DAE, 3DS, USDZ, AMF, VRML, OFF and point clouds with orbit controls, lighting, wireframe and screenshots.
- [GIF Compressor](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/gif-optimizer): Shrink GIFs and animated WebP with lossy compression, fewer colours, frame dropping or a target file size.
- [Animated Image Converter](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/animated-converter): Convert between GIF, APNG, animated WebP and AVIF, and turn video clips into GIF, APNG or WebP.
- [Crop Video](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/video-crop): Crop a video visually with aspect presets for Reels, Shorts and TikTok (9:16), square (1:1) and portrait (4:5).
- [Add Audio to Video](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/add-audio-to-video): Add music, replace the soundtrack, mix it with the original or add a second track, with a sync offset.
- [Images to Video](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/images-to-video): Make a slideshow video from photos with music, crossfades, a slow Ken Burns zoom and per-slide timing.
- [Open Any Archive](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/archive-extractor): Open ZIP, 7Z, RAR, TAR, GZ, XZ, ISO, CAB, DEB, RPM, JAR and more. Preview files and download what you need.
- [Subtitle Converter](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/subtitle-converter): Convert between SRT, VTT, ASS, SSA, SBV, SUB, LRC, SAMI, TTML, JSON and CSV in bulk.
- [Volume Booster and Normalizer](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/volume-booster): Make quiet audio or video louder, or even out loudness to a standard level (EBU R128).
- [E-book Converter](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/ebook-converter): Convert EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, CBZ, DOCX, PDF, TXT and more to EPUB, PDF, Word, HTML, TXT, Markdown or FB2.
- [Document Converter](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/document-converter): Convert DOCX, ODT, RTF, Markdown, HTML, TXT and EPUB to Word, PDF, Markdown, HTML, TXT, RTF or EPUB.
- [AI Summarizer](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/pdf-summarizer): Summarize PDFs, Word files and long text on your device, as paragraphs or key points.
- [Chat with PDF](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/chat-pdf): Ask questions about a PDF or document and get answers with page numbers, fully offline.
- [Data Format Converter](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/data-converter): Convert between JSON, YAML, XML, TOML, INI, CSV, NDJSON, MessagePack, CBOR and BSON.
- [CSV & Spreadsheet Editor](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/csv-editor): Edit CSV and Excel files in a fast grid: sort, filter, dedupe, find and replace, split and merge.
- [Encoding Toolbox (Recipe Chains)](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/encoding-recipes): Chain encodings: Base64, hex, Base32/58/62/85, gzip, URL, punycode, quoted-printable, MessagePack, protobuf and more.
- [Time Zone Converter](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/time-zone-converter): Convert times across zones, keep a world clock and find meeting times that suit everyone.
- [Metadata Scrubber](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/metadata-scrubber): Remove hidden data from photos, PDFs, Office files and MP3s in one batch: GPS, camera, author, company and more.
- [Password ZIP](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/zip-encrypt): Make an AES-256 password-protected ZIP that opens anywhere, or unlock one you have the password for.
- [Merge Excel Files](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/xlsx-merger): Combine sheets from many Excel, ODS or CSV files into one workbook, or stack their rows into one table.
- [LaTeX Equation Renderer](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/latex-equation): Type LaTeX and get a crisp equation as PNG, SVG or JPG, or copy it as MathML for Word.
- [Bank Statement Converter](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/bank-statement-converter): Convert OFX, QFX, QIF, CAMT.053 XML, MT940 and CSV bank files to CSV, Excel, JSON, OFX or QIF.
- [AI Receipt Scanner](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/receipt-scanner): Photograph receipts and get the shop, date, tax, total and line items as CSV or JSON, read by on-device OCR.
- [FIT File Converter & Viewer](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/fit-file-converter): Open Garmin, Wahoo, Coros and Zwift FIT files, see the stats, route and charts, and convert to CSV, GPX, Excel or JSON.
- [Document Leak Checker](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/leak-checker): See names, GPS, comments, tracked changes, hidden sheets, emails and keys inside files before you share them.
- [Remove Duplicate Rows](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/remove-duplicate-rows): Delete repeated rows from Excel or CSV, matching on all columns or the ones you pick, ignoring case and spaces.
- [Merge Word Documents](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/docx-merger): Combine DOCX files into one, keeping text, tables, images and links, with page breaks between them.
- [Caption Styler](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/caption-styler): Turn SRT captions into bold short-form captions with word highlight, then burn them into your video or export ASS.
- [Flashcard Maker](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/flashcard-maker): Make flashcards from a list, study them with spaced repetition, and export to Anki, CSV or printable cards.
- [Citation Generator](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/citation-generator): Make references in APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, IEEE and Vancouver for articles, books, chapters and web pages.
- [robots.txt Generator & Tester](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/robots-txt-generator): Build a robots.txt with rule groups and sitemaps, block AI crawlers in one tick, and test which URLs are allowed.
- [Schema Markup Generator](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/schema-generator): Make JSON-LD structured data for FAQ, Article, Product, Local Business, Event, Recipe, How-to and more.
- [Calendar Event Maker (ICS)](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/ics-creator): Make an .ics invite with reminders and repeats, plus Add to Google and Outlook calendar links.
- [Tone & Noise Generator](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/tone-generator): Play and download sine, square or saw tones, sweeps, white, pink or brown noise, binaural beats and phone keys.
- [Metronome & Click Track](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/metronome): Steady metronome with tap tempo, accents and subdivisions, plus a click track WAV download.
- [Instrument Tuner](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/instrument-tuner): Chromatic tuner for guitar, bass, ukulele, violin and more, live from your microphone.
- [BPM & Key Finder](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/bpm-finder): Find the tempo and musical key of songs in bulk, with tap tempo to check.
- [Find & Replace Text](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/find-replace-text): Find and replace in any text with many rules at once, whole words, match case and regular expressions.
- [Text to Handwriting](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/text-to-handwriting): Turn typed text into realistic handwritten notebook pages, then save PNG or PDF.
- [File Splitter & Joiner](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/split-join-files): Split any big file into parts (.001, .002) by size or count, and join parts back into one file.
- [Kindle Highlights Exporter](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/kindle-clippings): Turn My Clippings.txt into clean Markdown, CSV or JSON, sorted by book, with duplicates merged.
- [PDF Stamps](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/pdf-stamps): Add rubber stamps like Approved, Paid, Draft or Confidential, with a date line, to any PDF page.
- [Change Image Colours](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/image-recolor): Swap one colour for another or make a colour transparent, with tolerance and soft edges.
- [Image Stitcher](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/image-stitcher): Join images side by side, top to bottom or in a grid, and merge scrolling screenshots at their overlap.
- [Image DPI Changer](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/image-dpi-tool): Check and change the DPI of JPG and PNG files, or resize to an exact size in cm, mm or inches.
- [Signature Extractor](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/signature-cleaner): Turn a phone photo of your handwritten signature into a clean, transparent PNG.
- [SVG to DXF](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/svg-to-dxf): Convert SVG logos and drawings to DXF at real size in millimetres, for laser cutters and CNC.
- [Laser Cut Box Maker](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/laser-box-maker): Design a finger joint box from width, depth, height and material thickness, ready to laser cut.
- [Text to SVG Path](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/text-to-svg-path): Turn text in any font into outlined SVG paths or DXF, for logos, laser cutting and icons.
- [Data Profiler](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/data-profiler): A quick health check of any CSV, Excel or JSON file: column types, empty cells, ranges, outliers, duplicates and correlations.
- [SQL on CSV & Excel](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/sql-on-files): Run SQL queries on CSV, Excel and JSON files, join them together, and export the result.
- [AI Writing Helper](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/ai-writer): Fix grammar, change tone, shorten, expand, make bullet points or draft a reply with an AI that runs in your browser.
- [Anything to Markdown](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/any-to-markdown): Turn PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, HTML, EPUB, email and more into clean Markdown, one file or many at once.
- [Video Effects](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/video-effects): Add glitch, VHS, old film, mirror, kaleidoscope, pixel, sketch, heat map, neon, ghost trail and zoom pulse effects to a video.
- [Code to Image](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/code-to-image): Turn code into a clean picture with syntax colours, a window frame and a background, for slides, posts and docs.
- [Diagram Maker (Mermaid)](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/diagram-renderer): Write flowcharts, sequence, class, ER, Gantt, mind map and timeline diagrams as text and save them as SVG or PNG.
- [Chart Maker](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/chart-maker): Paste data and make bar, line, area, pie, donut and scatter charts, then save them as SVG or PNG.
- [G-code Viewer](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/gcode-viewer): See 3D printer, CNC and laser G-code layer by layer in 3D, with print time, filament and size.
